name: ferris-wheel-sunset-redhead-fashion
image_purpose: Festival lifestyle post and fashion moodboard

prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic sunset music-festival fashion portrait with a large illuminated ferris wheel behind the subject.
prompt.main_subject: One approved adult woman with long red hair and pink highlights, wearing the exact black strapless crop top, dark mini skirt, fingerless gloves, layered bracelets, and leopard-print scarf tied at the waist from the reference. Keep the confident fashion styling and natural adult presentation.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical fashion portrait with the woman standing confidently in front of the ferris wheel, festival crowd softly blurred behind, distant mountains, open grass, and small event lights. Center the wheel as a circular graphic frame without adding text or invented branding.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm sunset glow mixed with soft artificial festival lights, gentle edge light on red hair, natural shadows, lively free-spirited festival atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: 50mm lens, shallow depth of field, vertical portrait framing, photorealistic skin and fabric texture, subtle film grain, controlled highlights, slightly warm cinematic color treatment.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A photorealistic vertical fashion portrait of one approved adult woman with long red hair and pink highlights standing confidently in front of a large illuminated ferris wheel at a music festival during sunset. She wears the exact black strapless crop top, dark mini skirt, fingerless gloves, layered bracelets, and leopard-print scarf tied at the waist from the reference. A festival crowd, open grass, distant mountains, and small event lights sit softly behind her. Warm sunset glow mixed with gentle artificial lights, subtle edge light on her hair, 50mm lens, shallow depth of field, cinematic photorealistic detail, and free-spirited edgy boho energy.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, sexualized pose, child or teen appearance, celebrity likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, harsh flash, distorted anatomy, extra limbs, random text, watermark, invented logos, low resolution, blur
